title: The Division of the Land and The Lord Is There

questions.question: Which tribe is given the first portion of land at the extreme northern edge?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:1 (ESV): "These are the names of the tribes: Beginning at the northern extreme... Dan, one portion."

questions.question: What is the order of the remaining six tribes north of the holy district?
options: Asher, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim, Reuben, Judah
Issachar, Zebulun, Gad, Simeon, Benjamin, Judah
Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Dan, Naphtali
Ephraim, Manasseh, Benjamin, Levi, Judah, Issachar
questions.correctAnswer: Asher, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim, Reuben, Judah
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:2-7 lists them in order going south from Dan: Asher, Naphtali, Manasseh, Ephraim, Reuben, and Judah (who borders the holy portion on the north).

questions.question: Adjoining the territory of Judah, what special area is set apart?
options: The portion you shall set apart, 25,000 cubits in breadth, and in length equal to one of the tribal portions
The plains of Megiddo for chariot battles
The desert of the Wilderness of Zin
The hunting grounds of the prince
questions.correctAnswer: The portion you shall set apart, 25,000 cubits in breadth, and in length equal to one of the tribal portions
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:8 (ESV): "Adjoining the territory of Judah, from the east side to the west, shall be the portion which you shall set apart, 25,000 cubits in breadth, and in length equal to one of the tribal portions..." (This is the Holy District).

questions.question: Who receives the sacred portion of 25,000 by 10,000 cubits containing the sanctuary in the center?
options: The consecrated priests, the sons of Zadok
The poorest of all the tribes
questions.correctAnswer: The consecrated priests, the sons of Zadok
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:10-11 (ESV): "These shall be the allotments of the holy portion... It shall be for the consecrated priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept my charge, who did not go astray when the people of Israel went astray..."

questions.question: What is exactly forbidden concerning this holy portion of land for the priests and Levites?
options: They shall not sell any of it or exchange it, they shall not alienate this choice portion of the land, for it is holy to the Lord
They are forbidden to farm it or eat its produce
They must sell it every Jubilee year
They are forbidden to build any walls on it
questions.correctAnswer: They shall not sell any of it or exchange it, they shall not alienate this choice portion of the land, for it is holy to the Lord
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:14 (ESV): "They shall not sell any of it or exchange it, they shall not alienate this choice portion of the land, for it is holy to the Lord."

questions.question: Alongside the holy portion is an area 25,000 cubits long and 5,000 cubits broad. What is it used for?
options: It shall be for common use for the city, for dwellings and for open country. In the midst of it shall be the city
It is the prince's private burial ground
It is the area for burning refuse outside the camp
It is the grazing land for the wild beasts
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be for common use for the city, for dwellings and for open country. In the midst of it shall be the city
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:15 (ESV): "The remainder, 5,000 cubits in breadth and 25,000 in length, shall be for common use for the city, for dwellings and for open country. In the midst of it shall be the city."

questions.question: What are the dimensions of the city itself in the center of its property?
options: A perfect circle with a diameter of 10,000 cubits
It was not measured, for it was too large
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:16 (ESV): "And these shall be its measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500, the east side 4,500, and the west side 4,500." (A perfect square).

questions.question: Who will cultivate the open areas belonging to the city to provide food for those who work in the city?
options: The workers of the city, from all the tribes of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The workers of the city, from all the tribes of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:19 (ESV): "And the workers of the city, from all the tribes of Israel, shall till it."

questions.question: The entire allotted square (priests + Levites + city) is 25,000 by 25,000 cubits. What happens to the remaining land on the east and west of this square?
options: It is left desolate as a buffer zone
It is given to the foreigners
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:21 (ESV): "What remains on both sides of the holy portion and of the property of the city shall belong to the prince... "

questions.question: Which tribe's portion borders the holy district immediately on the south side?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:22-23 (ESV): "(so the property of the prince shall separate the territory of Judah from the territory of Benjamin.) As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west, Benjamin, one portion."

questions.question: What is the order of the final five tribes south of Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:24-27 lists them in order going south: Simeon, Issachar, Zebulun, Gad. (The total is 5 tribes south of the district: Benjamin, Simeon, Issachar, Zebulun, Gad).

questions.question: What is the southern boundary of the tribe of Gad?
options: From Tamar to the waters of Meribah-kadesh, from there along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea
questions.correctAnswer: From Tamar to the waters of Meribah-kadesh, from there along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:28 (ESV): "Adjoining the territory of Gad to the south, the boundary shall run from Tamar to the waters of Meribah-kadesh, from there along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea."

questions.question: How many gates does the new city have?
options: Twelve gates, three on each side
Four massive gates, one for each direction
questions.correctAnswer: Twelve gates, three on each side
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:30-34 describes three gates on the North, East, South, and West sides, for a total of 12 gates.

questions.question: What are the twelve gates of the city named after?
options: The twelve patriarchs from Adam to Noah
The twelve angels of God's presence
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:31 (ESV): "the gates of the city being named after the tribes of Israel..."

questions.question: What is the ultimate, final name of the new city at the very end of the Book of Ezekiel?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 48:35 (ESV): "The circumference of the city shall be 18,000 cubits. And the name of the city from that time on shall be, The Lord Is There." (Yahweh Shammah).

key_verse_text: "The circumference of the city shall be 18,000 cubits. And the name of the city from that time on shall be, The Lord Is There."
